text.es: Yo no creo en el destino, ni cosas así. Pero me resulta tan curioso que, precisamente, yo insistiese a Pelayo para que viniese a España de nuevo, y él trajese un periódico que resulta que yo hojeo, y encuentro unas fotos ﬁrmadas por Fina, y que ese resulte ahora el hilo del qué tirar para encontrarla. ¡No sé si es suerte o casualidad, pero es una locura!
text.en: I don't believe in fate or anything like that. But I find it so strange that it was precisely me who insisted Pelayo come back to Spain, and that he brought a newspaper that I just happen to leaf through, and I find some photos signed by Fina, and that this now turns out to be the thread to pull to find her. I don't know if it's luck or coincidence, but it's madness!
